text_block_list.text:
I'm gathering some data with Biwa
Hayahide in
preparation for our next
race when a muscle in my
arm twinges
painfully.
Crick.
Тренер?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ looks worried as she
watches me
hold my injured arm.

How much pain are you in? Where does
it hurt? Is
there any swelling?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
No, you're not! What if it's something
serious? We
need to get that looked at
right away!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: She drags me to the infirmary...
It's tendinitis.
text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor

text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You're going to have to give your arm
and hand
some rest. If it worsens, you
might even require
surgery.
text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
choice_data_list: I feel so bad about this...

text_block_list.text:
Icing the area won't be enough. You'll
have to
stop using your arm for a bit.
The good news is
there's no swelling, so
it's not too serious.
text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor

text_block_list.text:
If the pain is still unbearable after you've
rested it
for a while, come back so I can
look at it again,
okay?
text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor

text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, bit of a worrywart? I get the
feeling you
already knew the injury
wasn't that bad from the
start.
text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor

text_block_list.text:
But the fact that you insisted on coming
here
proves just how much you care
about your trainer.
text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor

text_block_list.text: I-I, uh...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
If you're feeling better in two or three
days, let's
go to a hot spring.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Because the least I can do is take care of
you,
and you need plenty of rest. You'd
better not
worry about my training for at
least a week.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You should apply for some time off and
take a
break. If something needs to be
handled right
away, we can ask Tazuna
to help.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I want you to contact me right away if
your
symptoms worsen or if you develop
a fever. And
on the day we go to the hot
spring—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me? Do you really think you're in
any
position to object?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
That look in her eyes... She's not messing
around!

The day of our hot spring getaway
arrives.

According to my research, the water
here is highly
recommended for soothing
medical ailments. It
should be
well-suited to heal your injury.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. This just so happens to be
the same
place I won a free trip to a
while back. Therefore,
we can enjoy this
vacation free of charge.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I do remember her
getting a
voucher for a hot spring
vacation some time
ago...
Let's not waste any time and go in.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

Phew... That was great. Did you enjoy
your bath
too?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Absolutely. All my muscle tension's gone.

text_block_list.text:
Good. That soak must've improved your
blood
circulation.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Next is dinner. I went ahead and ordered
a hot
pot for us. It's loaded with vitamins
B1 and B2,
beta-carotene, allicin—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, I should've asked if there were
any
foods you don't like. I did make sure
to avoid the
allergies you told me about,
but...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list:
No, it's not that. I just want you to slow down a
little.

text_block_list.text: ...Slow down?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: I want you to enjoy yourself, since we're here.

text_block_list.text:
You're constantly worrying about me
and putting
my needs ahead of yours.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: So why don't you just let me worry about you for once?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list:
I know you're concerned, but you need to take
it easy too.

text_block_list.text: Hmph...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list:
Come on, let's get some drinks to hydrate
ourselves.

text_block_list.text: ...Okay. Good idea.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Ahh...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Do you feel a little more relaxed now?

text_block_list.text:
I've been feeling relaxed from the
beginning,
since you're by my side.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Let's have them bring us our dinner now.
It'll be
nice to sit back and enjoy a meal.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
After our meal is brought to us, we enjoy
a
delicious and nutritious dinner
together.

I sense that Бива Хаяхидэ and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
